decisive_items: ST-segment elevation in leads V2 and V3
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most consistent support from the vignette, including ST-segment elevation, normal coronary arteries, and right ventricular dilatation, which are characteristic of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy. R1 is the runner-up because it also has some supporting evidence, such as right ventricular dilatation and elevated pulmonary arterial pressure, but it lacks the distinctive features of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy.

rejected.why: R3 is rejected because it is contradicted by the normal coronary arteries without stenosis, which rules out Acute Coronary Syndrome.
